# A card for the callback window

Mum tried the two-hour callback request and the receptionist accepted it without argument. We had treated the default as a rule. The waiting time is now predictable enough for her to visit the neighbour while keeping the phone nearby. [[Care arrangements]] should record the exact question that worked, with a reminder that another clinic might give a different answer.
